title: Shifts & schedules
subtitle: Shifts, rotational patterns, who works which shift, and the attendance rule sets that turn punches into results.

shifts.dialogHint: Times are local to the branch of the employee working the shift. A shift that ends after midnight counts for the day it starts.
shifts.deleteHint: Shifts that are assigned or used by a pattern cannot be deleted — end the assignments first.
shifts.emptyHint: Create a shift to define working hours; then assign it to branches, departments, teams or employees.

typeHint.FIXED: Fixed start and end times; lateness and early departure are measured against them.
typeHint.FLEXIBLE: Check in at any time; the expected check-out is the check-in plus the required time (and unpaid breaks).

shifts.endTimeHint: Earlier than start = ends the next day.
shifts.dayBoundaryHint: When the attendance day starts. A punch before this time counts for the previous day.
shifts.requiredTimeHint: Working time per day, not counting unpaid breaks.
shifts.coreOffHint: Off: people check in at any time and leave once they have worked the required time. Turn on only when everyone must be present during set hours.
shifts.coreBothNeeded: Enter both core times, or turn core hours off.
shifts.boundaryRange: With {{boundary}}, Monday's attendance day runs from Monday {{boundary}} to {{lastDay}} {{last}}.
shifts.boundaryTogether: Example: check in Monday {{in}}, check out Tuesday {{out}} → both punches count for Monday, so the night stays one working day. A punch on Tuesday from {{boundary}} counts for Tuesday.
shifts.boundarySplit: Example: check in Monday {{in}} → counts for {{inDay}}; check out Tuesday {{out}} → counts for {{outDay}}. The night is split across two days. Pick a time when nobody is working, e.g. 04:00.
shifts.coreHint: Everyone must be present between these times: arriving after the start counts as late, leaving before the end counts as early.
shifts.coreLongerThanRequired: The core hours ({{core}}) are longer than the required {{required}}: people will be expected to stay until the core end. Turn core hours off to let people check in at any time and leave after the required time.
shifts.noBreaks: No breaks — the whole span counts as worked time.
shifts.punchInWindowHint: How early before the shift a punch is accepted.
shifts.punchOutWindowHint: How late after the shift a punch is accepted.
shifts.graceHint: Replaces the rule set's grace for this shift.
shifts.graceOffHint: Off: the attendance rule set's grace applies.
shifts.minutesNeeded: Enter the minutes, or switch this off.
shifts.punchInOffHint: Off: punches are accepted from {{minutes}} min before the shift (platform default).
shifts.punchOutOffHint: Off: punches are accepted until {{minutes}} min after the shift (platform default).
shifts.breaksOnHint: Paid breaks count as worked time; unpaid breaks are taken off it.
shifts.breaksOffHint: Off: no breaks — the whole span counts as worked time.
shifts.colorOnHint: Shown next to the shift on the roster and in lists.
shifts.colorOffHint: Off: the shift uses the neutral colour.

patterns.hint: Rotational patterns repeat a cycle of shifts and off days from an anchor date (e.g. 4 days on / 2 off).
patterns.dialogHint: Pick a shift or Off for every day of the cycle. Day 1 falls on the anchor date.
patterns.deleteHint: Patterns in use by assignments cannot be deleted.
patterns.emptyHint: Patterns are optional — use them for rotating rosters.
patterns.noShifts: Create at least one active shift before building a pattern.

assignments.dialogHint: The most specific assignment wins: employee › team › department › branch › organisation. Overlapping ranges for the same target are rejected.
assignments.effectiveToHint: Included: the assignment still applies on this day. Leave empty for no end.
assignments.effectiveToBeforeFrom: The last day cannot be before the first day.
assignments.endHint: The chosen date is the assignment's last day: it applies up to and including it. Attendance after it is recalculated.
assignments.deleteHint: Removes the assignment entirely; affected days are recalculated.
assignments.emptyHint: Employees without an assignment have no shift and are flagged NO_SHIFT.

resolve.title: Resolve shift
resolve.hint: Check which shift and rule set apply to an employee on a given date.
resolve.pickHint: Pick an employee to see the resolution.

rules.hint: Rule sets are effective-dated. The branch-specific set in force on a date wins over the organisation-wide one; without any, the platform defaults apply.
rules.dialogHint: Changing a rule set that covers past dates recalculates the affected records.
rules.branchImmutable: The branch of a rule set cannot change; create a new rule set for another branch.
rules.deleteHint: Records computed with this rule set are recalculated with the next applicable one.
rules.branchHint: Leave empty for an organisation-wide rule set.
rules.effectiveToHint: The rule set stops applying on this date (the date itself is not included). Leave empty for no end.
rules.emptyHint: Platform defaults apply (10 min grace, 7 h full day, OT after 30 min). Add a rule set to customise.

sections.graceHint: How much lateness is tolerated and what counts as a full or half day.
sections.overtimeHint: The time worked after the shift end is overtime; here, when it starts counting and how it is rounded and capped.
sections.roundingHint: Round individual punches and/or the worked total.
sections.punchesHint: How raw punches are paired into IN/OUT and de-duplicated.
sections.missingHint: What happens when only one punch exists for the day.
sections.ramadanHint: Reduced scheduled hours for a date range.

fields.overtimeRequiresScheduledHours: OT only beyond the scheduled hours

hints.lateThresholdMinutes: Lateness beyond this is flagged (0 = any).
hints.minFullDayMinutes: Worked minutes needed for a full day.
hints.halfDayThresholdMinutes: Below full day but at least this = half day.
hints.overtimeEnabled: Turn off to never compute overtime.
hints.overtimeStartAfterMinutes: Minutes past the shift end before OT counts.
hints.countEarlyInAsOvertime: Minutes before the shift start count as OT.
hints.overtimeRequiresScheduledHours: On: a late arrival who makes up the time after the shift end earns no OT. Off: every minute worked after the shift end is OT.
hints.weeklyOffWorkCountsAsOvertime: All worked minutes on a weekly off day are OT.
hints.holidayWorkCountsAsOvertime: All worked minutes on a holiday are OT.
hints.punchInterpretation: FIRST_LAST: first punch IN, last OUT. PAIRED: alternate IN/OUT. DIRECTIONAL: trust the device direction.
hints.duplicatePunchWindowSeconds: Punches closer than this are collapsed.
hints.autoAbsentWithoutPunches: Mark employees with no punches absent after the shift ends.
hints.ramadanMinutes: Scheduled minutes per day during Ramadan (60–600).

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.subtitle: Holiday calendars per country or company; branches pick a calendar. Holidays can be limited to selected branches.
holidays.calendarHint: A branch uses one calendar; the default calendar applies to branches without one.
holidays.deleteCalendarHint: Calendars assigned to branches cannot be deleted.
holidays.isDefaultHint: Applies to branches without an explicit calendar.
holidays.noCalendarsHint: Create a calendar to start adding holidays.
holidays.endBeforeStart: Must be on or after the start date
holidays.pickBranch: Select at least one branch or apply to all branches.
holidays.dialogHint: Past holidays trigger a recalculation of the affected branches.
holidays.emptyHint: Add public, religious, company or regional holidays for this calendar.
holidays.tentativeHint: (date to be confirmed, e.g. moon sighting)
holidays.branchScopeHint: Turn off to limit this holiday to selected branches.
holidays.newDefaultCalendar: No calendar yet — a default calendar will be created and applied to every branch without its own.
holidays.defaultCalendarNote: Added to the default calendar: it applies to every branch without a calendar of its own.
holidays.appliesToNobody: This calendar applies to nobody: it is not the default and no branch uses it, so its holidays change no attendance. Make it the default, or pick it for a branch under Organisation → Branches.
holidays.recalcQueued: Attendance on these days is being recalculated.
holidays.noCalendarsMarkHint: Mark a holiday to start — a default calendar is created for you. Add more calendars only if branches follow different holidays.

policyEditor.invalidRepeatedLate: Between 2 and 31 late arrivals within 7 to 90 days.
policyEditor.invalidEscalation: Thresholds must increase from one step to the next, and each action can appear once.
policyEditor.noEscalation: No escalation: points are reported only.
policyEditor.packApplied: Filled in from the {{country}} pack ({{version}}). Review every figure.

sections.lateEscalationHint: Flags arrivals well after the start and counts repeated lateness for the points.
sections.dayHint: Worked minutes needed for a full or a half day.
sections.methodsHint: Which self-service check-ins employees on this policy may use (the organisation switches must allow them too).
sections.overtimeLimits: Weekly overtime, legal limits and rates
sections.overtimeLimitsHint: Used by the overtime summary and the payroll export; the engine's daily overtime is unchanged.
sections.pointsHint: Points per occurrence, counted over a rolling window; reaching a threshold calls for the escalation step.
sections.regularisationHint: Limits on the employees' own regularisation requests.

hints.veryLateAfterMinutes: Measured from the scheduled start, not after the grace. Empty = off.
hints.repeatedLate: N late arrivals within D days count one repeated-late occurrence.
hints.missingPunchBehavior: “Auto checkout at shift end” closes a day without a check-out at the end of the shift.
hints.weeklyThresholdMinutes: Worked minutes in a Monday–Sunday week beyond this, net of the daily overtime. Empty = off.
hints.maxDailyWorkMinutes: Days above it are reported in the overtime summary.
hints.pointsEnabled: Off: the points report shows this policy's employees with no points.
hints.expiryDays: A point counts for this many days, then drops off.
hints.backdateDays: A request may concern a day at most this many days ago.

scope.title: Who the policy is for
scope.hint: Every dimension you set must match; the most specific matching policy wins (shift > group > department > branch > country).
scope.immutable: The scope of a policy cannot change; create a new policy instead.

pack.title: Start from a country rule pack
pack.hint: Fills in the statutory day, overtime caps, weekly threshold, rates and Ramadan hours. Review every figure; sector and contract rules vary.

compliance.title: Compliance with {{country}} law
compliance.noPack: No rule pack for this country: nothing to check.
compliance.disclaimer: Warnings, not rules: the figures are the general private-sector law. Confirm with counsel.

codes.FULL_DAY_ABOVE_STATUTORY_DAY: Full day of {{value}} min is longer than the statutory day of {{law}} min.
codes.OVERTIME_CAP_MISSING: No daily overtime cap: the law allows {{law}} min of overtime a day.
codes.OVERTIME_CAP_ABOVE_LAW: Daily overtime cap of {{value}} min is above the legal {{law}} min.
codes.MAX_DAILY_WORK_MISSING: No statutory daily maximum: the law caps a day's work at {{law}} min.
codes.MAX_DAILY_WORK_ABOVE_LAW: Daily maximum of {{value}} min is above the legal {{law}} min.
codes.WEEKLY_THRESHOLD_MISSING: No weekly overtime threshold: the statutory week is {{law}} min.
codes.WEEKLY_THRESHOLD_ABOVE_LAW: Weekly threshold of {{value}} min is above the statutory week of {{law}} min.
codes.OVERTIME_RATE_BELOW_LAW: Overtime rate ×{{value}} is below the legal minimum ×{{law}}.
codes.RAMADAN_HOURS_ABOVE_LAW: Ramadan day of {{value}} min is above the legal {{law}} min.
codes.RAMADAN_NOT_CONFIGURED: Ramadan hours are not set: the law reduces the day to {{law}} min.
codes.SHIFT_LONGER_THAN_STATUTORY_DAY: The shift's {{value}} scheduled minutes exceed the statutory day of {{law}} min.

policyList.hint: Policies are effective-dated. Every dimension a policy names must match the employee on the date; the most specific matching policy wins, and without any the default rules apply.
policyList.specificityHint: Shift 32, group 16, department 8, branch 4, country 2: the highest matching policy wins.

whichPolicy.title: Which policy applies?
whichPolicy.hint: Pick an employee and a date: where they sit, the policy the engine applies and why the others do not.
whichPolicy.defaults: No policy matches: the default rules apply.
whichPolicy.lessSpecific: Matches, but a more specific policy wins

mismatch.DATES: Not in force on this date
